text:
sam-ops: Quick assist — saw a 10m spike of 502/504s on prod-ingress around ~08:12 UTC. Where's the minimal dashboard/queries I should link in a postmortem? Also need a couple of sample curl traces (req id) to attach. Anyone have the short runbook snippet for gathering request_id + trace URL?

anya-sre: Start with /dashboards/ingress-errors (Grafana) — panels to grab: '5xx by route', 'latency p50/p95', 'backend 502 by instance'. If it's an LLM route also check 'prefix-cache-timeouts' panel.

devon-platform: For traces use Jaeger: service=ingress + status_code>=500 and duration>200ms. Quick search: `service:ingress AND tags.http.status_code:[500 TO 599]` then filter by `tags.request_id`.

maria-observability: Quick curl to generate a traceable request: `curl -v -H \"x-request-id:mytest-$(date +%s)\" -H \"x-debug-trace:true\" \"https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate\" -d '{"input":"test"}'` — the response headers include `x-trace-url` when debug is enabled.

anya-sre: If you don't want to craft IDs, create one with python locally: `python -c \"import time; print('rid'+str(int(time.time())))\"` then search Kibana for `request_id:rid*`.

sam-ops: Nice. For the postmortem I want 3 representative traces + request timing breakdowns. Where do you export flamegraphs?

devon-platform: I can snapshot trace spans and export a small flamegraph from the traces service. Hit me with the request_ids and I'll attach PNGs.

maria-observability: For logs: Kibana query example: `service:ingress AND request.path:\"/v1/generate\" AND http.status_code:[500 TO 599]` then group by `route` and `backend_instance`. Use `@timestamp` descending and pick top 3 request_ids.

sam-ops: Thanks. One more — any quick alert tuning recs? Current prod alert fires on 5m window at 3.5% 5xx and pages on any hit. It's noisy during deploys.

devon-platform: Two options: 1) Change to a 10m window with threshold 2.5% and add a 30m sustained alert for paging. 2) Keep 5m but add an annotation label `deploy_quiet=true` to suppress alerts during canary windows. Either reduces noise.

maria-observability: Also split client 4xx (429/400) into a separate non-paging alert or mute via `source:client-burst` label — avoids false positives for downstream client spikes.

anya-sre: Minimal runbook snippet you can paste in the postmortem: 
```
1) Open Grafana -> Ingress Errors dashboard, note time range + route.
2) In Kibana run: `service:ingress AND request.path:\"/v1/generate\" AND http.status_code:[500 TO 599]` -> collect top request_ids.
3) For each request_id check log headers for `x-trace-url` or `x-request-id`.
4) Open Jaeger with that trace link, capture flamegraph + top spans.
5) If trace missing, re-run a curl with `x-debug-trace:true` and capture response headers.
6) If noisy, propose alert change: window=10m threshold=2.5% + sustained 30m page rule.
```

sam-ops: Great — I'll grab 3 request_ids and post them here. Thanks everyone. :pray:

alert-bot: Note: deploy_quiet window active 07:55-08:05 UTC — suppressing noisy alerts. :white_check_mark:

devon-platform: Ping me when you post req_ids and I'll produce trace snapshots + flamegraphs.

sam-ops: Will do. Appreciate the speedy help!
